findings: Allocations retain contiguous disjoint reserved episode ranges and stable worker-order action seeds.
Deterministic worker-index merge and local quota episode endings preserve GAE boundaries.
Exact resume retains the same saved worker allocation.
The real 16-process regression verifies closed checkpoint restoration, next rollout, weights, RNG and cleanup.
The harness uses sequential child sessions, production run_ppo, normal recording/checkpoints/local tracking, bound source identities and no retries.
The 900-second child budget and 960-second parent bound retain bounded session-scoped cancellation and cleanup.
Controller wall includes up to 0.25 seconds of polling and reading the child's timing report; spawn time measures dispatch rather than all initialization.

checks: All nine repetitions completed with 8192 trained decisions and no failed episodes or skipped updates.
Both rollout signatures and final model weights match exactly across all three repetitions within each worker count.
All runs performed two epochs per round and 1024 optimizer steps, with no KL early stopping.
All 36 actual production checkpoint/resume pairs passed restore, source/state bindings, saved worker allocation, counters and action/shuffle RNG checks.
Training episode origins match this corpus's training partition; no test evaluation and no partial records.
Only production differences from the preceding experiment are the PPO worker bound and CLI help.

independent_review.scope: PPO collector limit from 8 to 16, deterministic seed allocation, quota/GAE boundaries, same-count resume, cleanup and benchmark ownership/measurement.

interpretation: Timing repetitions, not learning-seed evidence; sample streams and episode cutoffs differ across worker counts.

protocol.initialization: Identical frozen 500k actor/critic; fresh Adam, action/shuffle RNG and cursor for every repetition.
limitations: Cross-count RNG streams and trajectories differ; workload-level scaling only.
Total rollout and minibatch settings stay fixed; per-worker quotas shrink.
Three repeats reuse the same seed per worker count; these are timing repeats, not learner seeds.
Background activity and temperature uncontrolled; each count occupies every order position.
Controller wall includes up to 0.25s polling delay and reading the child timing report.
Spawn seconds measure process-start dispatch; first collection includes full worker initialization.
No evaluation, corpus construction or inspector export inside training timing.
Peak memory is parent RSS only; it is not total pool RAM.
measurements: parent peak RSS, excluding worker memory
protocol.scope: CPU throughput and cutoff measurement only; no research model extension or playing-strength claim.
protocol.source_change: PPO collector maximum raised from 8 to 16; default, state guard, allocation algorithm, updates and same-count exact resume unchanged.
protocol.validation: Compare repeated trajectories/weights within each worker count; validate all checkpoint bindings and exact resume in focused tests.
